intent: TurnCompletedEvent is the memory-side typed view of the TurnCompleted event: session id, turn id, tenant id and the turn's messages. Identifiers must be non-null; the message list is copied immutably.

methods.signature: TurnCompletedEvent(String sessionId, String turnId, String tenantId, List<ContextEntry> messages)
methods.semantics: sessionId, turnId and tenantId must be non-null
